summary: Polygon's guide to the first themed event in Monster Hunter Now, the Halloween event running Oct. 25 to Oct. 31, 2023. It explains how to earn event-exclusive Pumpkin Tickets through Pumpkin Hunt Quests and by defeating the pumpkin rock Kulu-Ya-Ku, and how to use them to get and upgrade Jack-o'-Head armor. It also covers the armor's Solidarity (Pumpkin Hunt) skill, event dates, and the Halloween medal.
one_line: Guide to Monster Hunter Now's Halloween event: dates, earning Pumpkin Tickets, pumpkin rock Kulu-Ya-Ku, and getting and upgrading Jack-o'-Head armor.
key_facts: Monster Hunter Now's Halloween event is the first themed event for Capcom and Niantic's monster-hunting AR game.
The event runs from Wednesday, Oct. 25, at 9 a.m. to Tuesday, Oct. 31, at 11.59 p.m. local time.

Pumpkin Tickets and Halloween Pumpkin Hunt Quests are available from the start of the event; pumpkin rock Kulu-Ya-Ku and Halloween Medal Acquisition Quests arrive Saturday, Oct. 28, at 9 a.m. local time.
Pumpkin Tickets come from 18 Pumpkin Hunt Quests in the Special tab (one ticket per quest in step one, five per quest in step two) and from defeating pumpkin rock Kulu-Ya-Ku.
Both Pumpkin Ticket sources are available to players at Hunter Rank 11 and above.
Pumpkin Hunt step 1 quests include Obtain Lollipop Candy (10), Slay large monsters (15), and Slay monsters (30), each giving 1 Pumpkin Ticket and 100 HR Points.
Step 3 quests give 1,000 Zenny and 200 HR Points each, not Pumpkin Tickets.
Getting the Jack-o'-Head armor requires first earning 10 Pumpkin Tickets.
Niantic said that after 70 Pumpkin Tickets are spent on Jack-o'-Head upgrades, further improvements need only regular crafting materials.
The Jack-o'-Head armor has the skill Solidarity (Pumpkin Hunt), a party-based skill that increases attack power with multiple players, with its effect increased by five during the event.
Pumpkin rock Kulu-Ya-Ku appears in larger numbers than usual from Oct. 28 until the end of Oct. 31, in all three habitats (Forest, Desert, and Swamp).
Pumpkin rock Kulu-Ya-Ku tagged with paintballs during the event will keep dropping Pumpkin Tickets after the event ends.
The game's world map, encounter screen, and battle arena get a Halloween makeover with pumpkins.
